End-to-End Delivery: Take ownership of migrating legacy scripts, automation flows, and backend tasks from initial network path analysis through local verification and production rollout. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of hands-on software development and automation experience with Perl and Python in a Windows environment. Strong knowledge of Windows file systems (NTFS), network pathing mechanics (UNC format vs. local paths), process execution, and environment variables.
